customer_updates.name: Sonal Sharma
customer_updates.text: Extremely disappointing 1st experience with Furlenco. Ordered a bed, got delivered at a time of their convenience & wasn’t assembled. The delivery & warehouse guys said they’d install it the next day, which never happened. Called customer care, they assured it’ll be done in 24-48 hours. 5 days later, nothing has happened.  No communication or details of the person who would do it. I paid the full price and continue to sleep on the floor. DISGRACE. Still nothing is being done.

customer_updates.name: Adarsh Rajeevan
customer_updates.text:
One of the worst service I ever had in my life
The bed and wardrobe delivered on 14th Oct and till now there has no action from the team for the assembly of the product
Infact I have been continuously following up with them over call and mail
I would suggest everyone not to go with Furlenco as they dnt follow any ethics in customer service
Infact they will charge the entire amount for their horrible customer care service

featured_reviews.name: Sanchari Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst service! I have cancelled my subscription for a dining table and 4 chairs. The first pickup date was scheduled on 12th April. The driver didn’t turn up as he went on leave. No workaround provided. They scheduled the next pickup on 14th April, today. Driver calls up and says his vehicle is under fixing. No further information given. I called back the same number and he says he’s still delivering products to other customers and it will not be possible to pickup the stuffs. No options available to contact the customer service representative directly as they prefer to call back. I am a working woman. I can’t wait and stay back home everyday for them to come and pick up the goods. Simultaneously my purchased dining table has already arrived and there’s no space to walk in my living room. Most disgusting service staff. Think several times before you order anything from Furlenco!!!

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review after 2 weeks of total negligence from Furlenco. Please avoid renting from them at all costs. My experience has been a nightmare due to the following points:

• Safety Hazard: I rented a dining table 2 weeks ago. Two of the chairs delivered are damaged and have caused physical injury to my family.

• Ticket Manipulation: The only way to contact them is the app, but they keep cancelling/closing my service requests without any resolution. They simply cancel the ticket to avoid accountability.

• Lack of Access: There is absolutely no way to contact them easily. They have built a system specifically to hide from customers once they have collected the money.

• Unprofessional Staff: On the rare occasion I managed to connect with a representative, they were incredibly rude, arrogant, and dismissive of the fact that their product is causing harm. A Furlenco representative named Abrar finally came to inspect the product, but instead of fixing it, he damaged one of the chairs even further. He has become completely inaccessible and is ignoring all follow-ups.

Summary: Furlenco is happy to take your monthly rent but provides zero support when they deliver faulty, dangerous goods. I am now escalating this to the National Consumer Helpline.

featured_reviews.name: Agnibha Das
featured_reviews.review_text: Worse customer and delivery service. I was harassed by the customer service rep. I ordered 1 television which was not operational and there was no option on the app to return or file a complaint about product. Customer service is abysmal as it is not streamlined and takes a lot of time to connect with the representative. Moreover, while fighting with this issue I noticed that there was only 1 option to return the product which I proceeded with. Now they are saying that the product is returned and I will be able to avail its services in the following month after my payment is completed. I don’t know what to do as I have already paid for the product this month and haven’t been provided with a spare. The delivery does not provide the time they would be delivering the product. So they remain under assumption that we would be at home every time.

featured_reviews.name: Swapneel Malpekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Pathetic service and customer support. Delivered damaged product and no reply after raising complaint from last 4 days. Ruined our Ganapati festival experience for us.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Pathetic customer care service. You can’t directly talk to the customer service executive. Upon dialling the customer care number, you get to hear that the customer service executive will call within 30 minutes. It is sad to mention that this never happens. Despite waiting for 2-3 hours there is no call back.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Pathai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I rented a study table and chair from Furlenco and the overall experience has been excellent. The furniture quality is sturdy, well-finished, and very comfortable for long working or study hours. The chair provides good back support, and the table size is perfect for a laptop, books, and daily essentials.

Delivery was smooth and on time, and the installation was done neatly without any hassle. Everything was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as shown in the pictures. I also like the flexibility Furlenco offers with rental plans, which makes it a very convenient option without a heavy upfront cost.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and practical study or work-from-home setup. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Danny
featured_reviews.review_text: The app is full of glitches. Logistic service is pathetic. Customer service is very bad. Most days you cannot connect to customer service even after long wait. Even if you connect, they are rude and rarely helpful. Waste of time and money. Furniture is also of bad quality. They picked up furniture and no refund. No response to emails either.  I would not go for it.

featured_reviews.name: Dhiraj Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered furlenco unlimited premium, but service was so pathetic. The delivery guys ask for unnecessary money for delivery and installation. They didn’t installed complete furniture and told that some expert will come. Also complete furniture has yet not been delivered.
No customer executive to talk to, won’t suggest anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Mack D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely dreadful experience. My order for an alpha bed and mattress, placed on August 4th, 2023, turned into an ongoing nightmare. To start, they botched the delivery on August 5th, providing the wrong bed, and to make matters worse, the delivered bed was broken as the accompanying pictures attest.

As if the wrong and broken bed weren't enough, the mattress they provided proved to be incredibly uncomfortable. Without delay, I sought to cancel the mattress order. From that point forward, my days have been filled with ceaseless calls to their customer service, spanning well over five days.

After much anticipation, they finally took action on the 10th of August, only to replace the erroneous bed with yet another damaged and incorrect model. Throughout this entire ordeal, the uncomfortable mattress lingers in my possession, and their indifference toward facilitating a return is staggering.

Adding insult to injury, I find an email in my inbox on August 11th, 2023, declaring my issue resolved. Each time I've mustered the patience to contact their customer service, the response has been depressingly uniform: "We are escalating your issue." Regrettably, the direction or purpose of this supposed escalation remains an enigma to me.

I must emphasize that my prior experience with Rentmojo had been devoid of any issues, making the stark contrast with this current company all the more disappointing. It is my candid opinion that this company's performance falls far below par.

UPDATE on 16th August 2023 - Still stuck with the mattress and the wrong bed. Absolutely no communication from their team.

They suddenly called me one evening saying they would come the next day after evening. I agreed, but then the next day they called at 2 PM saying they would arrive within an hour.
